facts.base_unit_init: Only sets unit byte offset0x194=true; adds no group associations.
facts.base_unit_internal_create: Creates Application object-reference attributes and a GroupManager; method itself appends no Group items.
facts.group_manager_constructor: Delegates collection creation and sets class/name metadata; no association adds in this method. Subclass Init and agent overrides require independent checks.
facts.base_load_groups: Marks load flags, dispatches virtualFormatCgApplication0x100, then virtualGetApplicationObject0xe4/2Object0xe8 and sets Unit refs. Does not clear or append Unit.GroupManager.
facts.primary_application_provider: When raw Application attribute text empty, assign transient literal255; parse array then first element; ApplicationByAddress(address,true). Missing address can create and save a standard-named Application through the manager. No implicit native snapshot admission of such side effects.
facts.secondary_application_provider: Starts nil. Parses same raw Application; if second element present and <=255, ApplicationByAddress(second,true); otherwise remains nil. Negative/raw-domain and subclass behavior need independent admission.
facts.base_area: Returns nil. AsCSV always initializes area from its localized resource default and replaces it only for a nonnil Area object.
facts.base_interaction: Returns true for any index; report count still bounds emitted group slots.
facts.nil_application_csv: App1 flagbit7 and App2 flagbit8 unconditionally dereference the returned object when selected. Nil does not become blank. Each is inside the per-Unit CSV try block.
facts.unit_error_row: Per-Unit CSV exception replaces any partially built row with IntToStr(GetSimpleDecimalAddress) + comma + Error occurred when reporting Unit Programming. Literal error text is unquoted, has no trailing comma and replaces row irrespective selected columns. TStrings row addition supplies record framing separately.
facts.outside_error_block: Area getter and selected16group-slot projection occur before the per-Unit try block; do not generalize their exceptions into the caught error row.
facts.nullability_example: Base formatter turns raw56 into56 255 and empty raw into56 255 before provider resolution. Selected App2 therefore requires existing Application255 for a read-only native snapshot; it must not be reported as nil/error merely because original raw text had one integer. The nil-error branch remains conditional on an independently verified provider actually returning nil.
facts.base_application_formatter: At cb84c4..cb8658, read Application raw text; if nonempty parse first space-delimited integer then IntToStr. If Trim(raw) contains a space, parse second integer then IntToStr. Default missing primary to56 and missing secondary to255. Write canonical first+space+second back to the transient Application attribute before object providers. Complete domains and subclass bindings remain necessary.
